activity_statements.statement: designs and manufactures commercial jetliners (737 MAX, 777X, 787 Dreamliner, freighters) for airline customers worldwide, with 14,000+ Boeing aircraft in the global fleet
develops and produces military aircraft, rotorcraft, unmanned systems, weapons, and space/satellite technology for government and defense customers in 150+ countries

provides aftermarket maintenance, repair, overhaul, spare parts, digital analytics, and training through Boeing Global Services for commercial and defense customers regardless of original aircraft manufacturer
serves more than 90% of the global air freight market with its freighter aircraft line
employs 182,000+ people across the US and 65+ countries in engineering, manufacturing, and program management roles

name_reality_gap: The index label 'Aviation and Aerospace Component Manufacturing' understates Boeing's role as a prime defense contractor with billions in military programs — Boeing is simultaneously an OEM jetliner builder AND one of the world's largest defense companies, with a growing global services business that operates regardless of original aircraft manufacturer.
